create.name: Dr. Lisa Thompson
create.bio:
Dr. Lisa Thompson holds a PhD in biology from the University of Chicago and taught anatomy, physiology and animal evolution as a university professor before turning to spiritual work. She was also a dancer and choreographer, teaching jazz and contemporary dance at high school and college level. She describes herself as a lifelong experiencer of extraterrestrial contact and works as a channeller, speaking of connection with thirteen star families, among them the Arcturians, Pleiadians and Sirians. She is a certified past-life regression coach and brings Human Design and sound into her work. She lives in Waikoloa on the Big Island of Hawaii.

She created the Infinity Healing Method, which combines channelling with energy work, regression, sound, crystals and oracle cards, and she offers it as both a session and a training for practitioners. Her teaching includes guided channelled journeys, online courses on the multidimensional self and the wisdom of the galactic families, and private one-day retreats on the Big Island. She hosts the podcast Connection to the Cosmos and has written several books, including Connection to the Cosmos, Wisdom of the Galactics and Awakening to Your Multidimensional Self, alongside a range of oracle and affirmation decks.

books.title: Connection to the Cosmos: Remembering Your Galactic Heritage and Embracing Your Oneness
books.author: Dr. Lisa Thompson
books.description: Lisa Thompson's first book on extraterrestrial contact, drawing on her own experiences as a lifelong experiencer. It invites readers to consider their galactic heritage and a sense of oneness with the wider cosmos.

courses.title: Healing Frequencies of the Galactic Families
courses.description: A seven-week live online course on The Shift Network using Lisa Thompson's Infinity Healing Method. Each week focuses on the energy and teachings associated with one galactic family, such as the Arcturians, Pleiadians and Blue Avians, with recordings and a community forum.

courses.title: Wisdom of the Galactics
courses.description: A recorded programme of fourteen sessions: an introduction and one channelled meditation journey for each of thirteen galactic groups. It explores the qualities and messages Lisa associates with each group.

courses.title: The Multidimensional Self: A Journey Into Quantum Alignment
courses.description: A four-part recorded class series with guided energy attunements and simple daily practices. It focuses on connecting with the higher self and spiritual guides.

courses.title: Galactic Connection Retreat
courses.description: A private eight-hour retreat on the Big Island of Hawaii combining a session with Lisa, a shared dinner, an evening meditation and night-sky viewing at a chosen site. It is booked individually and has no fixed dates.

free_resources.title: Galactic Journey Meditation
free_resources.description: A free 20-minute guided meditative journey to meet your galactic guides and receive a message, with an accompanying PDF. It is sent by email after signing up.

flags: Her PhD is described differently in different places: Evolutionary Biology on her Shift profile, Organismal Biology and Anatomy on her own site; the bio says only 'a PhD in biology from the University of Chicago'.

Her own YouTube channel is a podcast of guest interviews where the guest is the main speaker, so the videos listed are interviews on other channels where she is the main speaker (two are joint uploads with her channel).
Content centres on extraterrestrial contact and channelling of 'galactic families'; a human may want to check it fits the directory's tone.
Shift course week on 'Mantis Beings' is described on its page as cellular and DNA healing; the course was kept (the title names no condition) but that wording was not used.
The Galactic Connection Retreat is a private one-to-one day; kept as a retreat because it is a fixed-price product, but it could be dropped under the one-to-one rule.
Several of her photos look heavily retouched or AI-enhanced, but all three show the same person.
left_out: Book Wisdom of the Galactics (ISBN-10 1951131622 from Open Library) and Connection to the Cosmos Oracle Deck (ISBN-10 1732408866): the amazon.com /dp/ pages returned HTTP 500 on several tries; worth a recheck.
Books Awakening to Your Multidimensional Self (ISBN 9798991896887) and Through Loss Into Light (ISBN 9798999203090): 979 ISBNs, no amazon.com ASIN found.
Books Sacred Soul Love and Sacred Soul Spaces: no ISBN or Amazon listing found.
The Love That Remains Healing Companion ($47): grief 'healing' guide, left out as borderline.
Infinity Healing Method certification: waitlist only, no price or page with dates; 'healing' modality also borderline.

Private sessions (Infinity Healing Method session, Past/Parallel Life Regression, Meet Your Galactic Family and Guides, Human Design readings), Multidimensional Awakening VIP Day ($1,999) and the 6-Month Mentorship: one-to-one work.
